_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Refresh and the tabs are locked while a notification is sending. The VM has four integrations: gh, llm, notify and reflection. A test notification waits until call "release", then succeeds. Call "sent" says whether the page has sent one ("true" or "false"). Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The modal" is ".integrations-modal". To "open the panel": press Control+k; ".command-palette-input" should be visible; fill it with "integration", click the first ".command-palette-item", and the modal should be visible. To "select" an integration N: click the first ".integrations-tabs button" (the list), then the ".integrations-name-btn" whose text starts with N followed by a space; ".integrations-detail-head strong" should then have exactly the text N. "The refresh button" is the modal's button named "Refresh"; "the Slack test button" is the button named "Test integration (webhook only)"; "the notify button" is the button named "Send test notification". To "close the modal": click the modal's button whose name contains "Close modal". To "start": navigate to /new, wait for the element with data-testid "message-input" to be visible, and open the panel. Perform the steps in order. 1. Start, and select notify. 2. Click the notify button, then call "sent" until it returns "true". 3. The refresh button should be disabled, and so should the first ".integrations-tabs button". 4. Call "release". The element with role "status" inside ".integrations-notify" should contain the text "Test accepted", and the refresh button should be enabled.
